# Pull requests are not accepted

civ4-debug-tools welcomes **issues, discussions and validation reports**. It does not accept pull
requests or third-party code or patches, because the maintainer cannot review contributed code for
this project safely and thoroughly. A change is proposed by opening an issue that describes it.

Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), then open an issue. To report a vulnerability,
follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). To tell us how the tool behaves on your system, use the
"Validation report" issue form.
